items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 24 at 8:35PM EDT until September 24 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
Small Craft Advisory issued September 24 at 7:45PM EDT until September 25 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt and seas up to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Northeast South Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
